pre_score_implementation_corrections.change: The uniform horizontal grid now extends to the first 5 m cell edge at or beyond the final thalweg point, with endpoint elevation held for the sub-cell remainder.
pre_score_implementation_corrections.reason: The initial floor-to-cell reconstruction ended 0.12 m and 1.17 m of surface arc before two otherwise valid observed trajectories. This was detected by the frozen source-domain check before those events were scored.
pre_score_implementation_corrections.unchanged: Engine source, parameters, event selection, metrics, thresholds, pass rule, and all other event results.

claim_boundary: This ablation compares the implemented open-snow point-particle dynamics with processed runout-defining GEODAR trajectories on their matched one-dimensional thalwegs. It is not release validation, deposit validation, occurrence prediction, a two-dimensional routing test, parameter calibration, or evidence of geographic generalization.

source.trajectory_semantics: T is radar time; R is radar range; S is surface arc length along the matched thalweg; V is trajectory velocity projected onto the thalweg. The picked and smoothed feature is usually the front but may be a major surge.
source.measurement_limit: The repository guide supplies 0.75 m radar range-bin spacing and processing lineage, but no per-trajectory positional or velocity uncertainty. No uncertainty-normalized residual is permitted.
source.geographic_scope: One instrumented path at Vallee de la Sionne, Switzerland.

selection_rule.files: Use every repository event that has both TRAJ-001.h5 and THALWEG-001.h5.
selection_rule.data_checks: T and S must be strictly increasing after removal of exact duplicate samples; all required values must be finite; the observed S interval must fall inside the reconstructed thalweg surface-arc interval.

profile_reconstruction.cross_slope_rule: Repeat the measured thalweg elevation across columns. This removes lateral routing and isolates along-path dynamics.
profile_reconstruction.longitudinal_rule: Compute cumulative horizontal distance from X/Y, interpolate Z to a 5 m horizontal grid extending to the first cell edge at or beyond the final source point, hold endpoint elevation over only that sub-cell remainder, and retain cumulative three-dimensional surface arc as the mapping to observed S.
profile_reconstruction.timing_rule: Reconstruct model elapsed time by integrating surface-distance increments divided by the adjacent-sample mean of the engine's along-path velocity, then align model and radar time at the first observed S.
profile_reconstruction.forest: unknown and therefore excluded from this ablation; all friction classes are fixed to the open-snow coefficient
profile_reconstruction.plan_curvature: not inferable from a one-dimensional thalweg and therefore held at zero with all friction classes equal
profile_reconstruction.missing_data: An event that leaves the reconstructed profile or reaches the step cutoff is a failed event, not silently excluded.

metrics.name: velocity_nrmse
metrics.definition: RMSE of model velocity interpolated at observed S versus observed V, divided by max(observed V)

metrics.name: relative_travel_time_rmse
metrics.definition: RMSE of model and observed elapsed time after aligning both at the first observed S, divided by the observed trajectory duration

metrics.name: terminal_surface_distance_relative_error
metrics.definition: absolute difference between the last modelled visited S and last observed S, divided by last observed S

aggregate_acceptance.event_pass_rule: All three metric thresholds pass and the model neither leaves the profile nor reaches the step cutoff.
aggregate_acceptance.interpretation_if_passed: Limited field consistency of the frozen open-snow along-thalweg dynamics ablation at one instrumented avalanche path.
aggregate_acceptance.interpretation_if_failed: The frozen dynamics ablation does not reproduce the public GEODAR trajectories under the declared reconstruction and parameters; failure cannot be repaired by post-hoc tuning on these events.
